// @molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/services/ui-surfaces: public API snapshot.
// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export type HostSurfaceAction = {
    readonly what: "pointer";
    readonly x: number;
    readonly y: number;
    readonly button: "left" | "right" | "middle";
    readonly clicks: number;
} | {
    readonly what: "key";
    readonly keys: readonly string[];
} | {
    readonly what: "text";
    readonly text: string;
} | {
    readonly what: "navigate";
    readonly url: string;
} | {
    readonly what: "wait";
    readonly ms: number;
} | {
    readonly what: "upload";
    readonly from: readonly string[];
} | {
    readonly what: "download";
    readonly to: readonly string[];
} | {
    readonly what: "scroll";
    readonly x: number;
    readonly y: number;
    readonly dx: number;
    readonly dy: number;
} | {
    readonly what: "drag";
    readonly x: number;
    readonly y: number;
    readonly to_x: number;
    readonly to_y: number;
} | {
    readonly what: "hover";
    readonly x: number;
    readonly y: number;
} | {
    readonly what: "app";
    readonly app: string;
} | {
    readonly what: "menu";
    readonly path: readonly string[];
};

export interface HostSurfaceActivity {
    readonly session_id: string | null;
    readonly summary: string;
    readonly point: {
        readonly x: number;
        readonly y: number;
    } | null;
}

export interface HostSurfaceDriver {
    readonly kind: HostSurfaceKind;
    readonly project_id: string | null;
    identity(): Promise<string>;
    scope(): Promise<string>;
    observe(kind: HostSurfaceObservationKind, context?: {
        readonly session_id: string | null;
    }): Promise<Uint8Array>;
    perform(action: HostSurfaceAction, context: {
        readonly session_id: string | null;
    }): Promise<void>;
    release?(): Promise<void>;
    close(): Promise<void>;
    describePoint?(x: number, y: number): Promise<string>;
    focusedField?(): Promise<{
        readonly label: string;
        readonly sensitive: boolean;
    }>;
    masked(bytes: Uint8Array): boolean;
    readiness?(context: {
        readonly session_id: string | null;
    }): Promise<{
        readonly refusal: HostSurfaceRefusal;
        readonly detail: string;
    } | null>;
    assess?(action: HostSurfaceAction): Promise<{
        readonly irreversible: boolean;
        readonly why: string;
    }>;
    currentApp?(): Promise<{
        readonly bundle_id: string;
        readonly name: string;
    } | null>;
    describeRound?(sessionId: string, context: {
        readonly run_id: string | null;
        readonly project_id: string | null;
        readonly goal: string;
    }): void;
}

export type HostSurfaceKind = "browser" | "desktop";

export type HostSurfaceObservationKind = "dom" | "accessibility-tree" | "screenshot" | "window-metadata";

export type HostSurfaceRefusal = "driver-unavailable" | "person-present" | "screen-locked" | "outside-target";

export interface HostSurfaceRefusalError extends Error {
    readonly refusal: HostSurfaceRefusal;
    readonly partial?: boolean;
}

export declare function isHostSurfaceRefusal(error: unknown): error is HostSurfaceRefusalError;
